Cluster 6 · Export Traceability, Raisins & Economics

GrapeNet EU MRLs, Sangli Raisins & Vineyard Profit per Acre

Direct Answer · GrapeNet Export, Raisins & Vineyard Profit

India exported 2.24 lakh tonnes (US$ 368M) of grapes to 46 countries in 2025–26 via APEDA GrapeNet (requiring NRL-NRCG clearance, ≥16°Brix, and 0–1°C cold chain). Bearing vineyards yield 10–14 t/acre at Rs 2.2–3.5L annual cost, generating Rs 2.5–5.5+ lakh/acre net in clean seasons [APEDA 2026; ICAR-NRCG].

APEDA GrapeNet Export Checklist & Cold-Chain Specifications

Direct Answer · Mandatory APEDA GrapeNet Standards

Register vineyard plots on APEDA GrapeNet from Day 1, clear NRL-NRCG Pune multi-residue sampling 15–20 days pre-harvest, harvest at ≥16°Brix (~20:1 sugar/acid, 16–18 mm berries), pack 4.5–5 kg ventilated cartons with dual-release SO₂ pads, and forced-air pre-cool within 4–6 hrs to 0–1°C (90–95% RH) [APEDA 2026].

Sangli GI & Vijayapura Raisin Making Protocol (25–26% Recovery)

Direct Answer · Indian Raisin (Manuka) Recovery & Dipping

For golden Sangli GI or Vijayapura raisins, harvest Thompson, Tas-A-Ganesh, Sonaka, or Manjari Kishmish (26.4% recovery at 22.4°Brix) at 22–24°Brix. Dip bunches 2–3 minutes in Ethyl Oleate (1.5%) + Potassium Carbonate (2.5%) and shade-dry on ventilated wire racks for 12–15 days [ICAR-NRCG; Somkuwar 2025].

1. Sugar Target

Wait until clusters hit 22–24°Brix (never pick at 16°Brix table stage) to achieve 25–26% dry raisin recovery.

2. Dipping Emulsion

Dip 2–3 minutes in Ethyl Oleate 1.5% + Potassium Carbonate 2.5% to crack waxy cuticle evenly for faster golden drying.

3. Shade-Rack Hygiene

Shade-dry 12–15 days in dust-free ventilated Vijayapura/Sangli sheds to preserve uniform green-golden grade and zero aflatoxin.

Vineyard Establishment Cost, Bearing Profit per Acre & Live Mandis

Direct Answer · Grape Farming Cost & Profit per Acre

Year 1–2 establishment (Extended Y-Trellis + drip + grafting) costs Rs 5.5–8.5 lakh/acre (Rs 10–14+ lakh/acre with UV plastic cover). Bearing maintenance (Year 3+) averages Rs 2.2–3.5 lakh/acre/yr, yielding 10–14 t/acre (25–35 t/ha) for Rs 5.5–10 lakh gross and Rs 2.5–5.5+ lakh/acre net in clean seasons.

GrapeNet Export, Raisin & Economics FAQs

What are the mandatory APEDA GrapeNet specifications for EU grape export?

EU export lots require active GrapeNet vineyard registration, NRL-NRCG multi-residue clearance 15–20 days pre-harvest, >=16°Brix sugar, ~20:1 sugar/acid ratio, 16–18 mm berries, 4.5–5 kg ventilated cartons with dual-release SO2 pads, and forced-air pre-cooling within 4–6 hours to 0–1°C at 90–95% RH [APEDA 2026].

What Brix and dipping solution give 25–26% Sangli/Vijayapura raisin recovery?

Harvest raisins at 22–24°Brix (Manjari Kishmish achieves 26.4% recovery at 22.4°Brix), dip bunches for 2–3 minutes in Ethyl Oleate (1.5%) + Potassium Carbonate (2.5%), and shade-dry in ventilated racks for 12–15 days [ICAR-NRCG].

What is the establishment cost, annual maintenance, and net profit per acre of grapes in India?

Year 1–2 setup (Y-Trellis + Drip + Grafting) costs Rs 5.5–8.5 lakh/acre (Rs 10–14+ lakh/acre with UV plastic cover). Bearing annual maintenance (Year 3+) runs Rs 2.2–3.5 lakh/acre, yielding 10–14 t/acre (gross Rs 5.5–10 lakh/acre, net Rs 2.5–5.5+ lakh/acre in clean weather/MRL seasons).
